title: DOC: add inline comment to 512-byte RSA verify stack buffer documenting max key size
description: src/wp11_backend_usb_flash.c line ~193: uint8_t out[512] in flash_verify is sized for RSA-4096 (4096/8=512 bytes). There is no comment explaining this relationship. A contributor adding support for a hypothetically larger key would overflow the stack buffer silently. Fix: add comment: '/* RSA-4096 output is 512 bytes — the maximum supported RSA key size. If larger keys are added, this buffer must grow. */' Also: consider whether wp11_keystore.h should document the maximum supported RSA key size as a contract, or whether wp11_keystore_create should reject keys larger than 4096 bits.
